source_gate: Two independent source-only reviews derive the four final answers and check numeric/paraphrase semantics against the original seed. Any definite source-gold error, unresolved gold ambiguity, invalid numerical-preservation or invalid harmless-paraphrase transformation rejects the whole family. P1/P2 must be well-posed with correct source final answers; added clauses need not cause an exact fixed number of extra steps. No question/gold edits or individual-variant replacement.
disagreement: Preserve both first judgments; coordinator resolves from source content before model inference. Unresolved substantive validity rejects the whole family.
replacement: Keep each accepted initial family in its fixed slot. Process rejected slots in ascending selection_slot order. Assign the next remaining source-valid reserve family in candidate_rank order; each reserve is itself reviewed before acceptance. Preserve rejected families and reasons. If fewer than32 source-valid families remain, stop rather than silently reduce the sample.
batching: Four distinct source families per request, same four-family block across variant types and models; never mix selection and confirmation. Model-facing prompts contain only opaque task IDs and question text.
target_scope: Numerical substitution and harmless wording are distinct variants; joint correctness across them does not test composition of both perturbations in one question.
no_performance: No solver/model task outputs have been generated or inspected during source selection.
